tasks.label: e2e (playwright)
tasks.detail: Browser regression suite; auto-starts Phoenix on port 4001 (psc_e2e DB)

tasks.label: check-audit-dir
tasks.command: cmd /c "cd /d C:\software\psc-elixir && (echo === docs/audit === & if exist docs\audit (dir /b docs\audit) else (echo MISSING) & echo. & echo === gitignore check === & git check-ignore -v docs/audit/2026-09-21-agentic-setup.md & echo. & echo === tracked in audit === & git ls-files docs/audit) > C:\software\psc-elixir\auditcheck.log 2>&1"

tasks.label: check-audit-2
tasks.command: cmd /c "cd /d C:\software\psc-elixir && (git status --short --untracked-files=all & echo === CHECK-IGNORE === & git check-ignore -v docs/audit/2026-09-21-agentic-setup.md & echo === LS-FILES === & git ls-files docs/ ) > C:\software\psc-elixir\auditcheck2.log 2>&1"

tasks.label: commit-work
tasks.command: cmd /c "cd /d C:\software\psc-elixir && del /q auditcheck*.log 2>nul & git add -A & git reset -q -- .gitattributes docs/spec/TODO.md & echo === STAGED === & git diff --cached --name-status & echo === COMMITTING === & git commit -q -F commit-msg-1.txt & git log --oneline -1"

tasks.label: check-commit
tasks.command: cmd /c "cd /d C:\software\psc-elixir && (git log --oneline -3 & echo === STATUS === & git status --short) > C:\software\psc-elixir\commitcheck.log 2>&1"

tasks.label: commit-work-2
tasks.command: cmd /c "cd /d C:\software\psc-elixir && git reset -q -- commit-msg-1.txt > commitout.log 2>&1 & git commit -q -F commit-msg-1.txt >> commitout.log 2>&1 & git --no-pager log --oneline -2 >> commitout.log 2>&1 & echo === STATUS === >> commitout.log 2>&1 & git status --short >> commitout.log 2>&1 & echo DONE"

tasks.label: renormalize
tasks.command: cmd /c "cd /d C:\software\psc-elixir && del /q commitcheck.log commitout.log 2>nul & git add --renormalize . > renorm.log 2>&1 & echo === RENORMALIZED STATUS === >> renorm.log 2>&1 & git --no-pager status --short >> renorm.log 2>&1 & echo DONE"
